newsitem.title: BOSNIA: EU gives $80 million for Bosnia's winter.
newsitem.headline: EU gives $80 million for Bosnia's winter.

text.p: The European Union said on Wednesday it had donated 65 million ecus ($80 million) for Bosnia's emergency relief winter programmes in its biggest single contribution to the war-torn country.
The European Community Humanitarian Office (ECHO) said in a statement issued in Sarajevo that it would be spending an additional 20 million ecus helping the needy in Croatia, Serbia and Montenegro.
Aiming to provide essential humanitarian aid and facilitate the return of refugees, ECHO channels its funds to the United Nations and 40 non-governmental agencies in Bosnia.
The latest donations bring ECHO's funding to the region to more than 1.3 billion ecus, the statement said. ($1=.8032 ecu)
